[LRST.1.5.1] When the correlation is an interpolated string
(`as "prefix-{binding}"`, an interpolation-eligible position per
[LGRA.2.9.6.8]), the string's type is always `String` — a legal
[LRST.1.4] key — but each interpolated binding is itself subject
to [LRST.1.5]: a segment that reads a nullable slot or a Json
sub-path is rejected (`DS_VALIDATE_AS_SOFTFAIL_EXPRESSION`). This
is stricter than a general interpolation, where a null value
renders as the empty string and compiles; a correlation key
must be non-nullable and non-absent so per-fact identity is
well defined.
